summary_en: Kawakami Paint raised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending November 2026 from 45 yen to 150 yen per share, an increase of 105 yen. The hike reflects improved earnings projections and progress toward the medium-term plan target of a 30% payout ratio when equity ratio reaches 40% or above.
title_en: Notice regarding revision (increase) of dividend forecast for fiscal year ending November 2026
translation_en_brief:
Kawakami Paint announced on October 15, 2026, that its board of directors resolved to increase the dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending November 2026 from 45 yen per share to 150 yen per share, representing an increase of 105 yen.

The company's shareholder return policy under its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ending November 2025 through 2027) aims to incrementally raise the dividend payout ratio during the plan period, targeting a 30% payout ratio once the equity ratio reaches 40% or above. The board made this decision based on the revised earnings forecast announced on the same day and a comprehensive review of the company's financial condition.

The revised dividend will be paid as an interim distribution in full at the fiscal year-end.
